label: Allan Gibbard, Reply to Commentators Pp.…: Gibbard distinguishes his special planning sense from…
locator: pp. 541–542, response to Seth Yalcin, planning and picking
interpretation: Historical reading of Gibbard’s own 2022 clarification, including his admitted special use and later abandonment of the term planning. This supplies motivation for distinguishing permission from single-action choice, not a formal semantics of conditionals or proof that the psychological explanation succeeds.
